lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: So you're the new rider everyone's on about? That 50 of yours won't fire, will it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Top end's gone. Bring it round and we'll sort it together. That's for the full game, mind.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Need a van to get to the tracks? I've got a used one out back. Six hundred quid, no haggling.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Parts for 50s and 65s, Grades 1 to 3. Shelves are empty in this test build, sorry.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Tyres, rims, spokes. Hard pack round here, so you'll want a hard-pack rear.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Looking for shifts? Come back when the job board's up and running.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Engines are my trade. Do enough jobs for me and I might let you use the practice yard.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: You race? There are three local tracks round here. The practice track's just past this gate.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: See you on the gate, then.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: This old machine? Put a clean part in and see what comes out. Not today, though.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Oh, hello! I'm always on this computer. Pop round any time.
